sectionIntro: Infrastructure, security, and data systems built as reproducible labs and reviewable prototypes.

projects.title: kube-rightsizer
projects.description: Turns historical Prometheus usage into p95 CPU and memory recommendations, then proposes reviewable GitOps manifest changes instead of mutating live workloads.

projects.title: three-tier-architecture
projects.description: Terraform modules provision a three-tier AWS topology across three availability zones, separating internet-facing web, application, and database tiers.

projects.title: observatory
projects.description: Pairs Terraform against LocalStack with an instrumented FastAPI service and a Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, and OpenTelemetry telemetry stack.

projects.title: sentinel-triage
projects.description: Clusters security events, evaluates Sigma rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and produces citation-grounded summaries for an analyst review queue.

projects.title: deploying-aws-webapp
projects.description: Terraform defines public and private networking, EC2, load balancing, RDS, and ElastiCache for a Dockerized Flask application.

projects.title: lakehouse-quality-gate
projects.description: Blocks downstream dbt builds when Great Expectations detects invalid data, with structured alerts and chaos modes that prove corrupt rows cannot pass.

projects.title: vuln-priority-engine
projects.description: Normalizes scanner findings, enriches them with EPSS and CISA KEV context, and ranks remediation work with an explainable policy-controlled score.

projects.title: pipeline-guard
projects.description: Combines container scanning with Terraform and Kubernetes policy checks, aggregates risk, and blocks pull requests above a configurable threshold.

projects.title: snowflake-dbt-tableau
projects.description: Moves raw sales data from S3 into Snowflake, models a fact table and seven dimensions with dbt, and presents the result in Tableau.

projects.title: atomic-detection-pipeline
projects.description: Emulates a PowerShell ATT&CK technique with Atomic Red Team, captures Sysmon telemetry, and verifies the resulting Wazuh SIEM alert.
